title: DRC Ebola Outbreak Becomes Fastest-Spreading on Record
summary: A Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has infected nearly 3,900 people with a 45% case fatality rate, per CDC and WHO situation reports, while a linked outbreak in Uganda has just ended.
